name: Physics-guided generative inverse and field models
name_zh: 物理约束生成与生成式反问题
summary: Condition generative models on observations or physics constraints to sample plausible inverse or forward solutions.
summary_zh: 在生成模型中加入观测与物理信息，用于生成解场、先验或反问题条件样本。
scope_note: Do not claim calibrated posterior samples without method-specific evidence.
scope_note_zh: 不能因为生成了多样样本就声称后验分布已校准。
